facts.apply_how: None — the event no longer runs.
facts.summary: FOLDED. A revered small German electronic festival at Bungalowdorf Olganitz that ran from 1997. No successor event was announced.

facts.name: Wilde Moehre Festival
facts.apply_how: The official site links a general participation portal at v.wildemoehre.org/participate covering performers, collectives, service providers and volunteers. No published deadline as of August 2026. This portal URL was cited on the official site but was not independently fetch-verified, so open it from wildemoehrefestival.de rather than trusting a copied link.
facts.when: August — 21-24 August 2026, Friday 16:00 to Monday 08:00 (verified, official site). IMPORTANT: the official site describes 2026 as 'the last Wilde Moehre Original' before the festival restructures — verify the format before targeting a future edition.
facts.cost: Ticket prices not stated on the official page checked; shuttle passes 10-16 EUR (2026).
facts.summary: A Brandenburg boutique festival with 12 floors of music plus workshops, lectures, theatre and performance, running around the clock. Organic, melodic and live-leaning electronic programming with a strong arts and community framing.
facts.verify: Contact source: IG named in footer of official kontakt page wildemoehrefestival.de/kontakt (Aug 2026)

facts.name: Elements Music and Arts Festival
facts.apply_how: No artist application was visible on the official site when checked (August 2026; the homepage returned outdated cached content). The team has historically taken artist submissions through their own channels — verify directly at elementsfest.us before pitching, and pitch the BangOn NYC promoter side in parallel.
facts.when: August — 7-9 August 2026 (JamBase and My Modern Met listings, 2026; the official homepage returned stale content when checked in August 2026). 2027 dates not yet announced.
facts.cost: Ticket prices not verified on an official page (August 2026).
facts.summary: A Pennsylvania forest camping festival run by the Elements/BangOn NYC team, with immersive production and a broad electronic bill spanning house, bass and live acts. Strong NYC-metro audience overlap.
facts.verify: Contact source: IG named on official Linktree linktr.ee/elementsfestival (Aug 2026); elementsfest.us blocked fetch, no email found

facts.name: Governors Ball
facts.city: New York, NY (Flushing Meadows Corona Park)
facts.when: Historically June. 2027 dates not yet announced as of August 2026.
facts.summary: New York City's largest multi-genre festival, promoted by C3 Presents and Live Nation, with electronic, indie, hip hop and pop programming. All ages.
facts.verify: Contact source: IG named on official Linktree linktr.ee/govballnyc (Aug 2026)

facts.name: Joshua Tree Music Festival
facts.apply_how: Open artist/band submission form on the Get Involved page; they state they listen to every submission but only reply if a slot opens. No published deadline — submit early for May/Oct 2027.
facts.when: Fall edition Oct 8-11, 2026 (verified on official site); spring edition each May, May 2027 dates not yet posted
facts.summary: Twice-yearly independent desert festival blending global, electronic and songwriter acts with a wellness/community layer. Closer to a transformational gathering than a rave.
facts.verify: Verified on official site: Oct 8-11 2026 dates and the existence of the open submission process. Direct form URL and deadlines not published on the page fetched; no booking email published. — Contact source: IG named on official contact page joshuatreemusicfestival.com/contact-us (Aug 2026)

facts.name: Wire Festival
facts.when: 2026 edition ran May 14-17 at Knockdown Center (verified via venue/press); 2027 not announced
facts.summary: NYC's leftfield techno/club-culture festival from the 99Scenes/Basement orbit — four days and nights at Knockdown Center.
facts.verify: 2026 edition and venue verified via Knockdown Center listing and press. Sound-fit judgment is mine, not theirs.
